timeline._readme: The media timeline (Ben, 2026-11-10): layers of firsts, stacked on one time axis across the dome. No world history. Edit here, then tools/talk/build_show.ps1 -Cards and Build World. y = where the item sits; y2 = a second date worth saying (not drawn yet). Dates are from memory, unchecked: verify 16 2/3 rpm, OBJ, FBX, volumetric. img = a picture in talk/timeline_img (Ben's, 2026-11-10; Pepper's Ghost, View-Master, NASA VIEW and Virtuality were added to carry his pictures: cut them if unwanted). Layer 5 (digital formats) is drawn as three rails: image, video, 3D. scale = [year, fraction along the arc]: later decades get more room.
